channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Zanin vota a favor de questão de ordem para redistribuir processo sobre Moraes
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Cristiano Zanin voted in favor of suspending the trial regarding an investigation into Alexandre de Moraes, preventing a decision on alleged ties with Daniel Vorcaro. The vote keeps the case ongoing without an immediate conclusion.

item.title: Para Planalto, Lula perde com crise e melhor cenário é investigar Moraes
item.description: The STF crisis hurts Lula's campaign, which faces a scenario with no favorable resolution for reelection. The Planalto strategy points to investigating Moraes as the only viable exit.

item.title: Mendonça acompanha Fachin, e placar vai a 4 a 2 sobre rito do caso Moraes-Vorcaro
item.description: Minister André Mendonça aligned with Edson Fachin's vote, leading to a 4-2 majority in favor of Gilmar Mendes's proposal to merge petitions 16,662 and 16,704 at the STF. The case involves complex legal discussions with procedural implications.

item.title: PRTB troca Marçal por Leonardo Avalanche na disputa à Presidência
item.description: The PRTB replaced Pablo Marçal with Leonardo Avalanche in the presidential race after the TSE rejected Marçal's candidacy due to party affiliation irregularities and ineligibility until 2032. Avalanche, the party's national president, took over the ticket and now runs with Silvia Helena da Silva Pereira as vice-presidential candidate.

item.title: Demanda por crédito subiu até 38% em faixa de renda que daria vitória a Lula
item.description: Credit demand grew 17.1% over 12 months through July, with a 38.8% increase among consumers earning one to two minimum wages, the income bracket where Lula leads voter intentions against Flavio Bolsonaro. The high demand for resources is linked to a heavy income burden from basic bills, reaching 87% among the poorest.

item.title: Lula tem 44% contra 37% de Flávio no 2º turno no PA, diz pesquisa
item.description: A survey by Real Time Big Data released on September 15, 2026, shows that Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) leads with 44% of voting intentions in a potential second round of the presidential elections in Pará, followed by Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) with 37%. The survey interviewed 1,600 voters between September 10 and 14, with a margin of error of 2 percentage points and a 95% confidence level.

item.title: Lula é aprovado por 60% e desaprovado por 38% em PE, diz pesquisa
item.description: A survey by Real Time Big Data shows that 60% of Pernambuco voters approve of Lula's (PT) work, while 38% disapprove. The poll interviewed 1,600 voters from September 10 to 14, 2026, with a 2-point margin of error and 95% confidence level, registered with the TSE.

item.title: Lula tem 59% contra 36% de Flávio no 2º turno em PE, diz pesquisa
item.description: A poll by Real Time Big Data, released on September 15, 2026, shows Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) leading with 59% of voting intentions in the 2nd round of the presidential election in Pernambuco, against 36% for Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ). In the 1st round, Lula has 56%, while Flávio has 25%. The poll surveyed 1,600 voters between September 10 and 14, with a 2-point margin of error, and was funded by Record.

item.title: Eleições: prazo para troca de candidatos se encerrou na segunda
item.description: The deadline for candidate substitutions in the 2026 elections ended on September 14, allowing changes only in case of death after that period. Some Senate candidates, such as Aécio Neves and Renan Calheiros, made substitutions within the legal deadline. In the presidential race, the TSE rejected Pablo Marçal's registration due to irregularities, with no replacement.

item.title: Senador aciona STF para pressionar Alcolumbre a instalar CPI do Master
item.description: Senator Alessandro Vieira (MDB-SE) filed a writ of mandamus at the Supreme Court to pressure the President of the Senate, Davi Alcolumbre (União Brasil-AP), to install the CPI of Banco Master, investigating the relationship of ministers with Daniel Vorcaro. The action aims to push for the opening of the commission, which has been stalled for six months, with 41 supporting signatures. The matter involves alleged irregularities concerning high court justices and the national financial system.

item.title: Possível blindagem a Moraes aproxima campanhas de Lula e Flávio
item.description: Investigations involving Minister Alexandre de Moraes may serve as bargaining chip between the campaigns of Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Flávio Bolsonaro, leading to unexpected alliances. The 2026 electoral landscape could see coalitions formed around shared interests to counteract Supreme Court pressures.

item.title: Defesa usará impedimento de Nunes Marques para questionar prisão de Vorcaro
item.description: The defense of Daniel Vorcaro intends to use Justice Nunes Marques' recusal to challenge the arrest of the banker, arguing inconsistency in the 2026 Second Chamber session. Marques voted to uphold the arrest but did not declare himself impartial, unlike Justice Toffoli, who recused himself due to suspected bias.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz que Lula ‘dividiu seu poder’ com Moraes em programa eleitoral
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, presidential candidate from PL, criticized President Lula and Minister Alexandre de Moraes during free electoral time, accusing the PT leader of sharing power with the STF and leaving Brazil without leadership. He also referenced the investigation into the funding of the film 'Dark Horse,' which involves him and banker Daniel Vorcaro.

item.title: Justiça Eleitoral suspende propaganda de André do Prado com Tarcísio
item.description: The Electoral Justice suspended André do Prado's campaign ad that featured Tarcísio de Freitas for more than the allowed 25% of airtime. Judge Domitlica Manssur ruled that the integration of images and the musical jingle excessively praised the governor, exceeding the legal limit of 7.5 seconds. The decision followed a lawsuit by Fernando Haddad's coalition, imposing a R$10,000 fine for any further unauthorized broadcasts.

item.title: Zanin aponta “inversão de lógica” no caso Moraes-Vorcaro
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Cristiano Zanin supported a procedural objection raised by Gilmar Mendes regarding the Moraes-Vorcaro case, arguing that analyzing an investigation before deciding on recusal would be a logical inversion.

item.title: 'Até a máfia tem ética': Veja frases marcantes da sessão do STF que discute futuro de Moraes
item.description: The STF holds a session to discuss the future of Alexandre de Moraes in the Banco Master case, with direct confrontations between justices regarding judicial decisions and impacts on public security. The deliberations reflect institutional tensions and debates about the role of the judiciary in conducting sensitive investigations.

item.title: Renan Filho tem 47% contra 43% de JHC no 2º turno em AL, diz pesquisa
item.description: A Real Time Big Data survey shows Renan Filho (MDB) leading with 47% against JHC (PSDB) at 43% in a potential runoff for the 2026 Alagoas gubernatorial race. The poll, registered with the TSE under AL-09248/2026, interviewed 1,600 voters from September 10 to 14, 2026, with a margin of error of 2 percentage points and 95% confidence level.

item.title: Presidenciáveis se manifestam sobre sessão do STF que discute investigação de Moraes
item.description: Presidential candidates commented on the historic STF session regarding the investigation of Minister Alexandre de Moraes, criticizing judicial overreach and supporting court reforms. Caiado and Zema backed Moraes' removal, while Lula remained silent.

item.title: Dino e Fux divergem sobre o que já foi feito no caso Moraes
item.description: During the STF hearing regarding an investigation involving Minister Alexandre de Moraes, Flávio Dino and Luiz Fux disagreed on whether a formal inquiry had been opened. Fux claimed no formal investigation existed yet, while Dino implied procedures were already underway.

item.title: Eduardo Bolsonaro ameaça expor julgamento do STF nos EUA para pedir nova rodada de sanções
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro said he intends to take records of the STF hearing on Alexandre de Moraes to the US to request new sanctions. He criticized ministers and lawmakers on social media while investigations advance against his brother Flávio for money laundering and corruption.

item.title: Nas redes, julgamento de Moraes ganha contornos eleitorais e vira debate sobre o STF
item.description: The trial involving Supreme Federal Court (STF) Minister Alexandre de Moraes became a central topic in electoral debates on social media, with 73,200 mentions between 8 AM and 1:59 PM. Discussions over who should judge the case and confrontations between ministers generated interaction peaks, particularly involving Moraes and André Mendonça, in a context blending judicial proceedings and political disputes.

item.title: Lula sanciona incentivo que pode levar a corrida bilionária por data centers no Brasil
item.description: President Lula signed the Redata law, granting tax incentives to attract data centers, with R$5.2 billion in tax waivers, requiring environmental conditions and R&D investments.

item.title: 3 ministros divergem de Fachin e Mendonça e votam por analisar em conjunto casos de Mendonça e Moraes
item.description: Three Supreme Court justices, including Alexandre de Moraes, voted to merge the cases against André Mendonça and Edson Fachin, while Fachin and Mendonça preferred to keep the proceedings separate.

item.title: Nove frases do julgamento de Moraes que mostram a tensão entre ministros do STF
item.description: The Brazilian Supreme Court began the trial of Justice Alexandre de Moraes over alleged ties with ex-banker Daniel Vorcaro, marked by internal tensions. Chief Justice Fachin opened the session emphasizing impartiality; Justices Nunes Marques and Toffoli recused themselves; Senator Dino challenged Fachin's removal of the case from Justice Mendonça, causing friction.

item.title: STF retoma em instantes sessão sobre vínculo de Moraes com Vorcaro; assista ao vivo
item.description: The STF resumes session to decide on investigation of Minister Alexandre de Moraes over ties with Daniel Vorcaro; Toffoli and Nunes Marques recuse to participate.

item.title: São Paulo concentra 18% das denúncias de propaganda eleitoral irregular do país
item.description: São Paulo leads electoral advertising complaints in Brazil, with 4,300 cases recorded in less than a month through the Pardal app, representing 18% of the national total (24,100). Most violations occur in public spaces, including misuse of urban furniture and 'leaflet dumping,' mainly in legislative candidate campaigns.

item.title: Após Binho Galinha, MPE já contesta 1.020 candidaturas no país
item.description: After the rejection of Binho Galinha's candidacy, the MPE has challenged 1,020 candidacies nationwide, about 5% of the nearly 21,000 requests received by the Electoral Justice. Most challenges occur in São Paulo, citing reasons such as unpaid electoral obligations and ineligibility.

item.title: A aposta dos aliados de Flávio para o placar do julgamento de Moraes no STF
item.description: Allies of Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) bet that most STF ministers will open investigation against Alexandre de Moraes in the Master case. They predict a 4-3 vote, with Moraes, Nunes Marques and Toffoli abstaining. The strategy aims to benefit Flávio regardless of outcome.

item.title: Bilhetes de Mendonça para Toffoli e abraço de reconciliação de Dino em Fachin; leia bastidores da primeira parte do julgamento
item.description: The first day of the STF hearing regarding the relationship between Minister Alexandre de Moraes and former banker Daniel Vorcaro was marked by tensions and disagreements, but also by moments of camaraderie among ministers. Despite the tense atmosphere, with limited interactions between some participants, President Edson Fachin opened the session greeting everyone, while ministers André Mendonça and Flávio Dino exchanged notes and symbolic reconciliation hugs.

item.title: Política para data centers deixa de fora regra sobre fontes de energia
item.description: President Lula signed the Redata law, but rules on energy sources for data centers await a future decree. Debate includes natural gas and low-emission sources, with internal government disagreements.

item.title: Juristas veem contradições em críticas a Fachin e alertam para mistura de casos no STF
item.description: Legal scholars question inconsistencies in the criticism of Edson Fachin and warn against risks of merging distinct cases at the STF, such as those involving Alexandre de Moraes and André Mendonça. Flávio Dino and Gilmar Mendes advocate for suspending the hearing and redistributing the case, but experts point to flaws in the arguments. The main concern is the weakening of the judicial process due to conflicts of jurisdiction and overlapping topics.

item.title: Julgamento do STF do caso Moraes-Vorcaro será retomado às 15h
item.description: The Supreme Court (STF) hearing on the Moraes-Vorcaro case will resume at 3 PM after a session suspension. President Edson Fachin announced the time change, while Minister Flávio Dino proposes delaying it to September 23.

item.title: Veja fotos de ato do Novo em Brasília contra Moraes e STF
item.description: Supporters of Romeu Zema and Flávio Bolsonaro held a protest in Brasília's Esplanada dos Ministérios, demanding pardons and criticizing President Lula and Minister Alexandre de Moraes, coinciding with the Supreme Court's decision on an investigation against the minister.

item.title: Celina Leão planeja criar bairros nas proximidades de nova linha de Metrô
item.description: Governor Celina Leão (PP) announced plans to create new neighborhoods near the Metro-DF Line 2, potentially enabling over 32,000 housing units through a land-value capture model. She also addressed the construction of an air-rail link between Brasília International Airport and downtown, ruled out tax increases, and emphasized the need for public exams in the health sector.

item.title: Dino confronta Fachin no STF: “Sua capa é igual à minha”
item.description: Minister Flávio Dino confronted STF President Edson Fachin during a hearing on Banco Master investigations, criticizing the redirection of cases handled by other justices. Dino expressed disagreement with the Court's conduct amid institutional tensions.

item.title: Flamengo lidera segundo turno do Brasileirão; Corinthians é lanterna
item.description: Flamengo leads the second half of the Brazilian Championship with 17 points after defeating Corinthians 2-1. Bahia follows in second place with 16 points, while Corinthians sits at the bottom with only five points. The team is likely to be relegated alongside Remo, Botafogo, and Red Bull Bragantino.

item.title: Mendonça e Gilmar discutem no STF: “Não aponte o dedo para mim”
item.description: Supreme Court justices André Mendonça and Gilmar Mendes clashed during a session regarding a case that may lead to an investigation of Justice Alexandre de Moraes over ties to Daniel Vorcaro, investigated for major financial fraud. Gilmar criticized Mendonça's conduct, alleging political bias, while Mendonça rejected the claims and defended judicial independence.

item.title: PF tem crise de credibilidade e é figura central no julgamento de Moraes no STF
item.description: During the Supreme Court trial regarding his ties to banker Daniel Vorcaro, Justice Alexandre de Moraes questioned the credibility of the Federal Police, which faces low public trust according to a recent survey. The PF was used by Moraes to accuse fellow justice André Mendonça, prompting criticism over a supposed 'parallel PF'.

item.title: Moraes acusa Mendonça de usar PF para incluí-lo em delação, e ministro rebate: 'É mentira!'
item.description: Supreme Court justices Alexandre de Moraes and André Mendonça engaged in a heated exchange over a Federal Police report linking Moraes to the owner of Banco Master. Mendonça accused Moraes of using him to try to get him into a plea bargain; Moraes denied with 'It's a lie!'

item.title: Nova lei cria crédito de até R$ 30 bilhões para renovação de veículos de taxistas e motoristas
item.description: President Lula signed a law creating a credit line of up to 30 billion reais for the renewal of taxi and rideshare vehicles, with gender-based interest rates and emphasis on eco-friendly models. The measure expands the use of FIIS and Peac-FGI funds and allows category B drivers to operate electric vehicles.

item.title: Após TSE barrar Pablo Marçal, PRTB quer Leonardo Avalanche como candidato à presidência; troca tem voto favorável de relatora
item.description: The PRTB party replaced Pablo Marçal with Leonardo Avalanche as presidential candidate after the TSE blocked Marçal's candidacy due to irregularities. Minister Estela Aranha, serving as rapporteur, voted in favor of the substitution, enabling the party's qualification for the 2026 election.

item.title: Em recado a Mendonça, Gilmar fala em “vazador geral da República”
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Gilmar Mendes criticized Justice André Mendonça's conduct during the hearing on investigations against Alexandre de Moraes, questioning the source of information leaks and accusing political-election bias. Mendonça responded by calling Gilmar 'frivolous' and requesting respect for the court. The full bench is reviewing a petition investigating Moraes's connection with Daniel Vorcaro and Banco Master.

item.title: ‘Crise sem precedentes’: Veja repercussão do julgamento histórico no STF na imprensa internacional
item.description: The historic hearing at Brazil's Supreme Court regarding a potential investigation into Minister Alexandre de Moraes sparked international media coverage, highlighting internal court tensions and their impact on the October presidential election.

item.title: “Quem não se dá respeito não merece respeito”, diz Gilmar a Mendonça
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Gilmar Mendes sharply criticized Minister André Mendonça during a court hearing, accusing him of conducting biased investigations against Alexandre de Moraes. The dispute arose in the context of an inquiry into alleged ties between Moraes and Daniel Vorcaro, investigated for financial fraud. The justices are debating whether the Federal Police can proceed with the investigations.

item.title: Entenda por que os ministros do STF usam toga
item.description: The use of the toga by STF ministers identifies the judges and symbolizes the impersonality and impartiality of Justice, as established by article 16 of the court's internal regulations. The 'Excelence' treatment is also part of this protocol.

item.title: Avocatória, suspeição e validade processual: o que significam os termos utilizados na sessão do STF
item.description: In a landmark hearing at the STF regarding an investigation into Minister Alexandre de Moraes, Justices Nunes Marques and Toffoli declared themselves disqualified and biased, respectively, due to procedural validity and ties to banker Daniel Vorcaro. STF President Edson Fachin took over the case’s rapporteur role, sparking debate over avocatura. Leaked messages showed Vorcaro made payments to Nunes Marques’ son, intensifying concerns over impartiality.

item.title: Ministro de Lula diz que sessão do STF vai ajudar eleitor a ver vínculos de candidatos com Master
item.description: Minister José Guimarães stated that the STF trial regarding investigations of Minister Alexandre de Moraes could help voters understand ties between candidates and the Banco Master scandal. The Lula government's strategy aims to link Flávio Bolsonaro to the case, while Lula avoids direct comments. The STF crisis may negatively affect Lula's image despite Moraes' support in the coup plot case.

item.title: ‘Quem tem medo da PF?’, dois ministros fora e Fachin questionado: a sessão do STF sobre as mensagens de Vorcaro a Moraes em 6 pontos
item.description: During the STF session on messages from Vorcaro to Moraes, ministers debated procedural conduct, recusals, and the PF's role. Fachin called for balance and plenary decisions. Nunes Marques and Toffoli recused themselves from the trial due to legal and ethical concerns.

item.title: Flávio faz pronunciamento sobre STF e diz que Brasil vive “crise institucional”
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro interrupted his electoral campaign to make a statement about the institutional crisis affecting Brazil, amid the Supreme Court trial and the dispute between ministers. He emphasized the seriousness of the current institutional situation.

item.title: Vídeo: Eleitores impedidos de votar poderão justificar pelo aplicativo do TSE
item.description: Voters who cannot attend the polls must justify their absence via the TSE app or in person at an electoral section. Failure to do so may result in restrictions on obtaining documents and participating in public competitions.
